title: Relationship Before Fundraising
primary_theme: Founder relationship-building and governance-heavy company building
founder_lessons: Bring unique market insight or unique experience to the first investor meeting.
Build investor relationships over time so the investor can observe your trajectory, not just a point-in-time pitch.
Value investors who will work through pricing, sales efficiency, compensation, recruiting, and conflict.
Do not treat capital as purely transactional; long-term companies need governance and collaborative tension.
notable_quotes: I'm investing in the trajectory of how I perceive you to perform over time.
I don't require you to have a completed product or to be in the market or to have data, but you have to bring something to the table.
That's the easiest part of my job.
